cs_pin.docs:
**[Pin Schema](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin-schema)**: The Chip Select pin of the SPI interface.

*See also: [MAX31856 Thermocouple Temperature Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/max31856#configuration-variables)*

mains_filter.docs:
**string**: The mains power frequency to reject (`50 Hz` or `60 Hz`  ). Defaults to `60 Hz`.

*See also: [MAX31856 Thermocouple Temperature Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/max31856#configuration-variables)*

spi_id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID of the [SPI Component](https://esphome.io/components/spi) if you want to use multiple SPI buses.

*See also: [MAX31856 Thermocouple Temperature Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/max31856#configuration-variables)*

thermocouple_type.docs:
**string**: The type of thermocouple used. MAX31856 supports: B, E, J, K, N, R, S, and T. Defaults to `K`.

*See also: [MAX31856 Thermocouple Temperature Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/max31856#configuration-variables)*

update_interval.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: The interval to check the sensor. Defaults to `60s`.

*See also: [MAX31856 Thermocouple Temperature Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/max31856#configuration-variables)*
